notes.title: My Life as a Maiden is out!
notes.content:
There are five heroines in this visual novel about a boy going to a strict all-girls school. He must keep the fact that he is male a secret from the other students.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/754840/My_Life_as_a_Maiden/

notes.title: Difficulty Mode Added
notes.content: For those that were struggling, you can now choose between easy or hard mode when starting a new game. Easy mode starts off with a lower target score and increases by a lower amount after each successful stage.
